messages:
emily_marketing: Hey team — marketing needs a tight, reproducible bench bundle for next Wednesdaywebinar. We want raw CSVs, nvprof traces, run commands, and a one-paragraph narrative that explains tradeoffs. Can eng/runtime take this on?

kevin_runtime: Yep. Can you confirm models, infra, and the exact artifacts you want? Also where to drop outputs?

emily_marketing: Models: redwood-v1-1b (prod tag) and open-llama-7b. Sequences: 128, 512, 1024. Batches: 1, 4, 16. Quantization: fp16 baseline and int8 if stable. Prefix cache: on/off. Hardware: on-prem H100, aws g5, and an intel-silver CPU node for baseline. Please push everything to s3://redwood-marketing/bench/webinar-apr and include the exact command lines + git commit or model hash.

ajay_ml: Add a small quality check: greedy decode 100 holdout prompts and compute token-overlap and a simple n-gram precision (chrF or token-F1). Flag if int8 token-overlap drops >4%. Use fixed seeds and disable dropout.

tina_data: Ill upload 100 holdout + 200 mixed prompts to s3://redwood-marketing/bench/webinar-apr/payloads by EOD. Ill mark prompt length categories.

kevin_runtime: Plan: smoke today (seq128 x batch 1/4) on H100 and g5. Full matrix overnight: seq 128/512/1024 x batches 1/4/16 x cache on/off x quant fp16/int8 (skip int8 when unsupported). Well record p50/p95/p99 token latencies, tokens/sec, peak GPU memory, per-run cost estimate, and per-token streaming latencies for streaming cases. Example harness command (varies per infra):

```bash
python infra/bench/run_bench.py \
  --model redwood-v1-1b \
  --device h100 \
  --seq_len 512 \
  --batch_size 4 \
  --prefix_cache True \
  --quant fp16 \
  --runs 8 \
  --seed 777 \
  --out s3://redwood-marketing/bench/webinar-apr/results/redwood-v1-1b/\
```

kevin_runtime: Outputs: per-run CSVs, nvprof traces, run_metadata.txt with docker image, git sha, pytorch/cuda versions, kernel flags, and a short ops-fallback log for quantized runs. ci-bot will enqueue jobs.

ci-bot: :gear: queued bench job webinar-1764101122 for 12 configs. Monitoring s3://redwood-marketing/bench/webinar-apr/.

kevin_runtime: For cost calcs well report both on-demand cloud pricing and our internal committed H100 equivalent. Please confirm committed rate to use for marketing slides.

emily_marketing: Use internal committed H100 rate + AWS on-demand. Acceptance: either p95 < 130ms for seq128 batch1 on H100 for redwood-v1-1b OR a balanced narrative with a cost-per-1M-tokens estimate. Must include raw CSVs, command lines, and a one-paragraph narrative (3 bullets max) for slides.

ajay_ml: Small ask for int8 runs: include calibration traces and note any operators that fallback to fp16. Ill review the quality check outputs.

legal_bot: If publishing numbers, include: hardware, region, model hashes, exact harness link, and pricing assumptions. Avoid absolute superlatives.

kevin_runtime: Starting smoke runs now. Ill post the first CSVs to s3 and update this thread. If quota or nondeterminism issues show up well call them out in run_metadata.txt.

emily_marketing: Great thank you! Ping when first artifacts are available so we can start slide drafts. :rocket:
